integrity: Analytical universal proof and independently constructed finite computational checks are provided. Finite checks are not proofs of universal statements; no independent audit or external certification has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted adjacency continuous-time walks only; two or more clique blades of at least two vertices, core of at least one vertex; no assertion for singleton blades, alternate Hamiltonians, or weighted joins. The entire full dissertation PDF could not be inspected, so unlocated overlap is possible.
title: Exact rank and uniform positive spectral gap for heterogeneous clique-cored windmills
